title: Video-generation startup PixVerse raises $439M, valuation soars past $2B
slides: PixVerse just raised $439M—but what's their edge?
They generate realistic videos from text in seconds.
Most competitors still cannot match motion consistency.
You can now create product demos without filming.
Test their free tier today—before your competitors do.
thread_text:
1. $439M for what?

PixVerse’s Series B values it more than most AI video startups combined.

2. They solve motion drift.

Competitors' videos warp objects between frames. PixVerse holds edges and textures steady across cuts.

3. No crew needed.

A one-line prompt replaces a full production shoot. Product demos now run on text.

4. Time is the moat.

While rivals refine labs, PixVerse ships to users. Speed becomes the defensible advantage.

5. Can you afford delay?

Visit PixVerse today, feed it a product description, and watch a demo render. If it saves one shoot, test it this week.
